summary: Three defects the working street gate found by rendering frames rather than by geometry. (1) roof.shell drew 1.97x its building's plan — an ~8 m eave — in four settlements; RULED as a units slip rather than authored intent (the caller passes over: 0.45-0.80 m to all three roof kits and this one never read it; drum() takes radii and 15 of its 16 call sites pass one), fixed to footprint + the authored eave on a squared eaves plate so the dome's four corners stay covered, and the roof's real extent is now PUBLISHED via kits.js roofPlanExtent(). A second overhang in the same part — ribs cut to max(w,d) and swung radially, 2.77x on archon-shrine — fixed with the shell's own chord. (2) Gideon's black ground DIAGNOSED, not fixed: it is the authored region palette, blackwood ground #14231A at luminance 3.6/255 rendering to #020202 at 2.1 against 25.5-107 for the other seven towns; null control that swaps only that one authored value moves Gideon 2.1 -> 44.9 and leaves all seven others identical. The fix is one value in regions.json or a floor in province.js, both of which have other live claimants, so it is handed over with a stated acceptance. (3) region_reported was not one bad row but ALL 48 rows in all eight towns — it read sim.env.region, which no engine code updates from position (INVENTORY V15, open, W1-02/W1-30F); deck.mjs now records region_at_player from getTerrainAt() and renames the cached field so V15 stays visible.

rulings.id: the eave was wrong, not the footprint
rulings.reversal: three edits inside registerKit('roof.shell') in game/src/render/lib/kits.js — restore drum(r1*2, r0*2) with band.scale.set(w,1,d), delete the shelleaves slab, restore Math.max(w,d)*0.96 as the rib length. EXECUTED on a hard-linked control clone; 1.97 came back to the digit on the same buildings.
rulings.falsifier: a settlement document, art-direction plate or region record asking for a deep sheltering canopy over the street in the shell towns. If one exists the answer is still not to re-widen this part — build the canopy as public realm, where the street can be planned around it and collision can know about it.

roof_shell_coverage_min.note: the eaves plate keeps it at 1.0 at ANY eave including zero, so coverage cannot discriminate the fix from its null control — stated, not assumed

hardware_evidence.what_the_frames_show: The approach shots carry the roof fix plainly: before, every Helstrom building is a wide pale cap with a sliver of wall under it (the critic's 'the same wide hipped roof repeated across the whole town'); after, the walls are the building, with windows, timber framing and the shell sitting on them at a size that reads as a roof. Held across t0800/t1300/t1930 and clear/rain. street-helstrom and street-lilmoth are proper 4-8 m street reads.
hardware_evidence.what_the_frames_falsified: Soulrest's street shot is STILL enclosed and roof.shell was not the cause. A 16-ray enclosure probe (tools/render/w1-30e-street-enclosure.mjs) run on the shipped tree AND the delete-the-fix clone gives identical answers for all eight settlements: open sky over the player and over the camera at every one, nearest wall to the Soulrest camera 6.98 m. The remediation report's §4 attributed it using an axis-aligned bounding box on a rotated building — a 17 m plan turned 45 degrees has a 24 m AABB — so the roof defect it found is real and its Soulrest attribution is not. The enclosing thing is not in buildSettlementExterior's output and is UNIDENTIFIED.

not_done: Gideon's ground is diagnosed and NOT fixed — the fix is game/data/world/regions.json (W1-25-persistent-builder) or game/src/world/province.js (five live claimants); editing either from here is the Ruling O1 failure.
build-deck.mjs does not yet read roofPlanExtent() — the publication exists, the join does not; that file belongs to W1-30V and W1-30DE-REMEDIATION.
No naive-judge read of whether a shell town now reads as architecture or as a row of boxes. Geometry cannot answer it and the pack must be built by an agent that is not the judge.

Soulrest's street shot is NOT fixed and its cause is NOT identified — it was handed over as a roof.shell consequence and the ray probe falsifies that in both arms. Open, not closed.
Gideon's ground is still black in the new hardware frames, exactly as expected — nothing here changed it.
